### The Only Foundation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-only-foundation
Passage: Isaiah 28:16-22
Points:
- During a season of trial and discipline, God gave His people a promise of peace through a laid cornerstone.
- The New Testament reveals that Jesus Christ is this precious cornerstone and the only reliable foundation.
- False confidences, human schemes, and deceitful refuges will crumble when God's righteous judgment sweeps through.
- Safety from divine wrath and eternal destruction comes solely through resting in Christ and His righteousness.
- Believers are challenged to examine their lives and ensure their confidence and ministry are built on Christ alone.
